notes.title: Sandstorms, upgradeable units and more lasers!
notes.content: [h1]Greetings Calyx players![/h1][p][/p][p][b]We’re thrilled to say that over 60,000 of you now have the Calyx Demo installed.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]It’s now time for an update on what we’re planning next.[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/e1e1e80195544424b8b4f827fba8cfc3ea9ff27c.png"][/img][/p][h3]Here are some of the things we’re working on…[/h3][list][*][p]Events system – changing situations occur; for example, a sandstorm that reduces solar power and weapon range.[/p][/*][*][p]Calyx species get even stronger, and lash out when attacked.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrade system – build the Unit Workshop to unlock unit upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Formation types – select different shapes for groups of units and hit shift to flip them 180 degrees.[/p][/*][*][p]Zeus Cannon unit – it’s a big laser tank![/p][/*][*][p]Ore Thumper building – makes an Ore patch regenerate faster, but uses a lot of power.[/p][/*][*][p]Flamethrower Turrets – a fiery new variant for your defences.[/p][/*][*][p]New Challenge maps.[/p][/*][*][p]More QOL improvements inc:[/p][list][*][p]Show attack ranges of all objects[/p][/*][*][p]Disable chromatic aberration[/p][/*][*][p]Change autosave interval[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust volume of voices separately[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Plus lots more smaller tweaks, balancing and polish items.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’d like to say a huge thanks to everyone who’s played, reviewed and wishlisted so far. We’re thrilled so many of you see potential in the project![/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for another update soon, and in the meantime, come and check out our growing Discord community: [url="https://discord.gg/3awHP4Cz"]https://discord.gg/3awHP4Cz[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]Cheers![/p][p]John, Mark and Phil :)[/p][p]Studio 568[/p]

notes.title: The Calyx Demo Update Playtest Is Now Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Calyx players![/h2]

Our playtest for version 2 of the Calyx Demo is now open.

If you already requested access, you should now have the "Calyx Playtest" product in your Steam Library.

To request access now, visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3211850/Calyx/]main Calyx Steam page[/url] and hit the button under “Join the Calyx playtest”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/b5a0c14233d2f341150671784b28e290e05eee91.gif[/img]

[h3]There are lots of new things to try out, including:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Challenge Mode with 5 new maps.
[*] New Calyx plants with new mechanics - watch out for the crawlers!
[*] Existing Calyx species have been upgraded.
[*] Calyx now level up - they get stronger the longer they're alive.
[*] New player units.
[*] Harvester based mining system.
[*] New resource - Isotopes!
[*] Boost Modules in the world - connect these to power for a bonus.
[*] "Drawable" walls and pylons.
[*] Re-bindable keys, adjustable UI scaling, and lots more QOL features.
[*] Original music from our long time collaborator Gavin Harrison.
[/list]
The tutorial has been updated with the major new systems, so that's a good place to start if you're new to Calyx or a seasoned pro.

We’re excited to hear what you think, and it would be super helpful if (once you’ve played) you could [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf3zWAm3X9Ygr2ljFwpJE8vMIh7h4lZwbbOFbL2bJY1n0qnLg/viewform?usp=header]fill out our playtest questionnaire[/url].

We hope you enjoy it.

Thanks!

John, Mark & Phil ːsteamhappyː
Studio 568

notes.title: Sign up for the Calyx Demo Update playtest
notes.content:
[h2]Sign up in advance[/h2]
Visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3211850/Calyx/]Calyx Steam Page[/url], scroll down and hit the “Request Access” button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/94ecf7026dcc217202375b7a7f301853396bf365.png[/img]

[h2]“When can I play?”[/h2]
When the playtest is available we’ll publish another news post to let everyone know.

[h2]The playtest includes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Challenge Mode with 5 new maps.
[*] New types of Calyx.
[*] Existing Calyx are more sophisticated.
[*] Targeting system revised.
[*] New player unit types.
[*] Harvester based mining.
[*] Draw walls and pylons.
[*] New resource - Isotopes.
[*] Harvest, Healing & Power Boost Modules.
[*] Lots of new QOL features including re-bindable keys.
[/list]

[h2]New features – sneak preview[/h2]

[h3]Bastion[/h3]
[h3][i]Calyxa Castellum[/i][/h3]
This tough new Calyx rains down fire on any unit that strays into range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/c9282f453c9936136bb778eee30ee09d3cba8494.gif[/img]

[h3]Militia[/h3]
[h3][i]Calyxa Militum[/i][/h3]
This new species spawns creatures which attack your units and base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/6484345aecf6603249b447783cac387916b10a58.gif[/img]

[h3]Tormentor[/h3]
[h3][i]Calyxa Tormenta[/i][/h3]
The pink Calyx now has a proper name and more sophisticated behaviour. You can also see the new Orbital Laser weapon being used to take out a trunk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/3fd15fa53896a59e31b684314fa4acfc4ab9bf55.gif[/img]

[h2]Razorleaf[/h2]
[h3][i]Calyxa Propagare[/i][/h3]
Our old friend the green Calyx is also more advanced, growing additional nodules and levelling up in strength over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/c4447dbef4137ba157c7b9ffe8827df8973381cc.gif[/img]

[h3]Harvesters[/h3]
We’ve added a Harvester based mining system with a new Refinery building to collect that sweet Ore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/6854c7af877a6ab3ad28ebc7e7f1f1592129ad6f.gif[/img]

[h2]Player survey[/h2]
We’ll be creating a short survey so you can give feedback on the new features. There will be a link to the survey from within the playtest build.

[h2]Thanks for your support![/h2]
More than 50,000 players have now installed the Calyx Demo, which frankly blows our minds. We can’t wait to hear what you think of the new additions.

Thanks!

John, Mark & Phil ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Calyx Development Update – March 2025
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Calyx players![/h1]

We’re delighted to say that more than 35,000 of you have now added the Calyx Demo to your library, since we first launched it for Steam’s RTS Fest on January 20th.

Thanks for all your detailed suggestions and feedback. We spent time reading and digesting your contributions, and combining them with our own.

It’s now time to give you a quick update on what we’re planning next.

It’s our intention to share a bigger slice of the game with you, and we’re aiming for around the middle of 2025 for the demo update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/672d768c986ffc7bc359fe958b13a742c4570f42.png[/img]

[h2]Here’s some of the stuff we’re working on…[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated targeting system for player units
[*] New types of Calyx plant
[*] New units (including plant units that make defenses far more important)
[*] A new resource
[*] A new mining system based on harvesters (no more trying to place mines to clear up every last scrap of ore)
[*] Existing modules and buildings in the world - connect to these for boosts
[*] More maps
[*] Lots of QOL features including more options and keyboard shortcuts
[*] Many smaller improvements
[/list]

We hope that gives you a good idea of where Calyx is going next.

We’d like to say a huge thanks to everyone who’s played, reviewed and wishlisted so far. We’re stoked so many of you see potential in the project!

Stay tuned for another update soon.

Cheers!

John, Mark and Phil ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Huge thanks to everyone who played the Calyx Demo during RTS Fest!
notes.content:
[h1]Big thanks from the Studio 568 team![/h1]

We're thrilled that so many of you played Calyx over the RTS Fest period, left reviews and gave us feedback in the Discussion Forum.

It's exciting that so many of you see potential in the Demo, and it's great to receive so much well considered feedback.

We're now working through that feedback, pulling out the common themes, and using them as part of our decision making for the next phase of the project.

If you want to keep up with our progress, please add Calyx to your wishlist!

Cheers,

John, Mark and Phil ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Calyx Demo v0.0.2.3 | Skirmish
notes.content:
[h1]Added Skirmish as an option on the main menu.[/h1]
[i]This allows you to configure options before playing the demo map:[/i]
[list]
[*] Number of Calyx Roots
[*] Number of Ore locations
[*] Difficulty, from Very Easy to Impossible
[/list]
Note, this is not us responding to any of the super helpful player feedback. Skirmish is a small feature that didn't quite make the cut when we launched the demo on Friday, so we're including it today.

Thanks!

John, Mark and Phil ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Calyx Demo v0.0.2.2
notes.content:
[h1]Frame rate cap & motion blur options[/h1]

[*] Frame rate cap
[*] Motion blur
[/list]
These are in the options dialogue - if you've seen the game maxing out your GPU, you can now impose a framerate cap. We also made some minor UI and audio tweaks.

Thanks!

John, Mark & Phil ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Calyx Demo v0.0.2.1
notes.content:
[h1]Updated music[/h1]

Some YouTubers got in touch to say they've been receiving copyright violation notifications when monetisation is enabled on their videos of Calyx.

Although the music we used in v0.0.2.0 was Creative Commons licensed for commercial use, we could see it was going to be an uphill battle for each content creator to get their individual videos cleared to use it.

For that reason we sourced updated music and created a new version.

Any YouTubers who create videos from v0.0.2.1 or later can email us at calyx@studio568.co.uk and we'll help get their videos cleared asap.

Thanks!

John, Mark and Phil :)

notes.title: The Calyx Demo is now live
notes.content:
[h1]We're stoked to announce you can now install and play the Calyx Demo. 
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/0409ec42ef240a3edc03c8da99967ebab0675475.png[/img]

A strategy game with a new kind of enemy, Calyx puts you in charge of a space mining outpost, locked in battle with an overwhelming alien organism. Build your base, gather resources, assemble your forces, and take on the Calyx. With only an out-of-date AI for company, can you survive?

[b]This demo is an early sample of our vision for the full game. It includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] A tutorial level to teach you the basics.
[*] An alpha quality, mid-game level to show how the final experience might feel.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/fae7a8b3e88618d55eda438fe7f6b82921e9e40a.png[/img]

We’d love to hear your thoughts on the demo to help shape future development. Please jump into the Discussion Forum and let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/405c3a92bdabb60a08f60ae7d0544708cc3c4bba.png[/img]

Thanks! ːsteamhappyː

John, Mark & Phil – Studio 568

notes.title: Calyx Demo coming in time for Steam RTS Fest
notes.content:
[h1]Our demo is almost here![/h1]

A quick note to say we're putting the final touches to the Calyx demo and hope to share it with you very soon. Our aim is to have the demo live in time for Steam's RTS Fest event which starts on Monday 20th January. We might even get it out sooner depending on how our final playtesting goes.

We're stoked to see the initial reaction to the first Calyx video, and we're excited to see what you think when you play. ːsteamhappyː

Please add Calyx to your wishlist and stand by! 

Thanks! John, Mark and Phil
